description: Fixed prompt set for scripts/live-captures/capture.py. Each prompt is sent once to every model profile in evals/model-profiles.yaml with the profile's sampling, seed and thinking setting. Tools come from fixtures/toolformat/tools.json. Changing a prompt changes every capture, so keep the set small and stable.

messages.content: What is the weather in Tokyo right now? Use the tool.
Get the current weather in Paris and in London, in celsius. Call the tool once per city.
Search the web for the latest Go release notes.
Say hello in one short sentence. Do not call any tool.
What is 17 multiplied by 23? Answer with the number only.
